description: Source file implementing absl::Status methods, including status code to string conversion, payload management, and error creation functions.

classes.name: absl::Status
classes.description: Represents an error status with code, message, and optional payloads.

methods.description: Outputs the string representation of a StatusCode.

methods.name: Status::ForEachPayload
